$comment: The only URLs this project is allowed to send a user to. Source of truth for the list: SFDI/CENDIS signpost, re-checked at least once a year. If a country is missing, we say so and link its ministry of transport. Never a reseller.

signpost.name: SFDI / CENDIS — e-vignettes in Central Europe

portals.notes: Single official state e-shop. Validity check for a plate is on the homepage. Offline distributors: Czech Post, EuroOil and RoBiN OIL stations — same price.
Only official sales channel. Since March 2026 also at regional post offices (Posta 1) at the same price.
Also sells section tolls, and the Slovenian e-vinjeta as an authorised DARS partner with no surcharge. ASFINAG's terms exclude resale of digital toll products by third parties.
National and county (varmegyei) e-matrica. Year of validity is chosen at purchase and cannot be corrected afterwards.
Authorised online resellers exist (ASFINAG, Petrol, ADAC) and sell at face value. DARS forbids sale through unauthorised shops.
No vignette exists. Distance-based toll paid at the gate on exit. Nothing can be bought in advance. Free-flow system (Crolibertas) announced for 2027-03-01.
